title: Gaadi Ko Deewar Dikhti Nahi, Sirf Sunti Hai 🚗 #shorts
description:
Reverse parking mein gaadi deewar se pehle kaise ruk jaati hai? Jawab hai ek chhota HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor.
🔊 40 kHz ki anasuni awaaz ka ping
🧪 Piezo disc 3D mein andar se
⏱️ Echo time se distance: microseconds ÷ 58 = cm
🔌 Arduino ke saath TRIG aur ECHO wiring
🧽 Kapda aur tirchi deewar kyun fail hoti hain
Aur 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo!
